exposure: Presence or absence of the 'sliding sign' on ultrasound
outcome: Accuracy of the sliding sign in predicting intra-abdominal adhesions
cohort: 112 pregnant women undergoing a scheduled repeat cesarean delivery at a regional hospital
finding: The study found that the sliding sign had limited clinical value in predicting intra-abdominal adhesions, with a sensitivity of 53.3% and specificity of 80.4%.
